values.name: Calculation net
values.description: The price stated is the net price including allowances/ charges. Allowances/charges may be stated for information only.

values.name: Calculation gross
values.description: The price stated is the gross price to which allowances/ charges must be applied.

values.name: Allowances and charges not included, tax included
values.description: The price does not include the allowances and charges, but includes the taxes.

values.name: Average selling price
values.description: Average selling price of a product.

values.name: Information price, excluding allowances or charges, including taxes
values.description: The price stated is for information purposes only and excludes all allowances and charges. Taxes however are included in the price.

values.name: Information price, excluding allowances or charges, and taxes
values.description: The price stated is for information purposes only and excludes all allowances, charges and taxes.

values.name: Calculation price
values.description: The price stated is the price for the calculation of the line item amount.

values.name: Information
values.description: The price is provided for information.

values.name: Invoice price
values.description: Referenced price taken from an invoice.
